name: yt-resume-firefox
description: A local-first Firefox extension that resumes standard YouTube videos.

scripts.lint: npx --yes web-ext@10.6.0 lint --source-dir . --ignore-files package.json package-lock.json tests tests/** README.md PRODUCT.md DESIGN.md .impeccable/** web-ext-artifacts/**
scripts.start: npx --yes web-ext@10.6.0 run --source-dir . --target firefox-desktop --ignore-files package.json package-lock.json tests tests/** README.md PRODUCT.md DESIGN.md .impeccable/** web-ext-artifacts/**
scripts.build: npx --yes web-ext@10.6.0 build --source-dir . --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts --overwrite-dest --ignore-files package.json package-lock.json tests tests/** README.md PRODUCT.md DESIGN.md .impeccable/** web-ext-artifacts/**
